title: Animal Jumps
introduction: ‘Animal Jumps’ is developed as a mathematical investigation rather than a list of rules. The chapter connects multiples, factors, common multiples, number patterns, jumping along a number line. Learners are expected to represent quantities or relationships, choose a strategy, calculate carefully, check the result and explain the reasoning.
